name: Audio Reactive Pyramid
description: Three-level Laplacian-style sharpening pyramid whose band intensities are driven by matching FFT frequency bands: coarse detail by bass bins (0–12), mid detail by mid bins (13–50), fine detail by treble bins (51–127). A small silence floor from the gain sliders keeps it a gentle detail enhancer without audio. Depth-routed bands: with a depth map, near subjects take the fine-detail boost while distant areas get gentle coarse softening (aerial perspective); a flat or missing depth map falls back to the plain pyramid. Per-band chroma split: added coarse-band halos lean warm and added fine-band edges lean cool, leaving flat neutral areas neutral. Compatible with the ford442/flac_player FFT wire format (128 bins in extraBuffer[5..132]).
